name: Declared Native Composite Struct-Member Bundle Production (native-composite-attempt)
description: C02/C10 produce demo: the declared `native-attempt` route builds a bundle from a module exercising the composite struct-member admission — a non-generic `struct Point { x: i64, on: bool }` member, struct-typed atom parameters, `p.f` field reads and a same-struct pass-through call — the record pins the v4 member profile and the v1 composite source profile; `native-check` re-derives under the same gate; a struct whose field is a refined alias stays refused.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the composite struct-member profile end to end: `native-attempt` produces a bundle whose record names mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v4 with source_profile mumei.pure-i64-composite/v1, `native-check` rechecks it consistent under that same gate, and a struct field typed by a refined alias selects nothing.
success_criteria: report.json carries schema mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json) and a non-null selected_result
bundle/native-bundle.json pins profile mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v4 and source.source_profile mumei.pure-i64-composite/v1
native-check on the v4 bundle reports bundle_check consistent with discharged file_identity
bad_report.json carries no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the composite struct-member profile end to end: run `python -m agent native-attempt` on a module declaring a struct member, struct-typed parameters, field reads and a pass-through call, assert the record pins the v4 member profile and v1 composite source profile, recheck the bundle through `native-check`, then show a refined-alias struct field produces no claimed build_id and no selection.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_composite_attempt/src/main.mm (struct Point with i64/bool fields, atoms taking `p: Point`, field reads `p.x`/`p.on`, pass-through call `read_x(p)`) and bad.mm (struct field typed by refined alias Port, outside the admitted field vocabulary).
Step 1 runs the declared `native-attempt` route and asserts report.build_id equals sha256(native-bundle.json), record profile v4, source_profile composite/v1, and all five bundle members on disk.
Step 2 runs `native-check` on the produced bundle pinned to the reported build ID and asserts bundle_check consistent with discharged file_identity under the v4 gate.

Step 3 reruns `native-attempt` on the refined-alias-field source and asserts no build_id, no selection, no partial bundle, and a nonzero normalized exit_code; a direct Core invocation records the profile-gate rejection diagnostic in bad_direct.log.
Generate evidence: attempt.log, check.log, bad.log, bad_direct.log, build_id.txt, report.json, check_report.json, bad_report.json, bundle/, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
notes: The v4 member profile widens admission to non-generic structs whose fields are all `i64`/`bool`: a struct parameter flattens to one scalar input per field in declaration order and only passes through by name to a same-struct sibling parameter; the record pins the admitted profile by name so a recheck re-derives under the same gate.
The reported build_id is the Core-computed sha256 of native-bundle.json — the exact identity a native-check call pins via --expected-build-id.

bad.mm declares `struct S { port: Port }` over `type Port = i64 where v >= 1 && v <= 65535;` — refined-alias fields stay outside the v1 composite fragment (the verifier does not yet assume field-type domains for struct fields), so the whole module is out of profile rather than silently re-admitted under a narrower gate.
Every step exits the pipe-and-grep form so a failed command cannot pass silently as exit-0 output.
budget_policy_fingerprint is native-composite-attempt-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Produce a v4-profile native bundle through native-attempt
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_composite_attempt/src/main.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/attempt.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/attempt.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json, hashlib; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['build_id']==hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(); assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert r['candidate']['schema_version']=='mumei.verifier-evidence-candidate/v1'; rec=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); assert rec['profile']=='mumei.native-pure-i64-module-linux-x86_64/v4', rec['profile']; assert rec['source']['source_profile']=='mumei.pure-i64-composite/v1', rec['source']; import os; [open('{output_dir}/bundle/'+n).close() for n in ('native-bundle.json','program.ll','program.o','proof-cert.json','program')]; open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt','w').write(r['build_id']); print('native-attempt produced v4 bundle, build_id verified'); print(rec['profile']); print(rec['source']['source_profile'])"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with build_id equal to sha256(native-bundle.json), a non-null selected_result and a candidate; the record pins the v4 member profile and composite v1 source profile; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0; build_id matches the Core-computed record digest, the record names the v4 profile, and the bundle directory is complete.

steps.name: native-check rechecks the v4 bundle consistent
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-check --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_composite_attempt/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/check_report.json > {output_dir}/check.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/check_report.json; cat {output_dir}/check.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/check_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-check-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['bundle_check']=='consistent', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['file_identity']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; print('native-check on v4 bundle: consistent, file_identity discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: check_report.json holds mumei.native-check-report/v1 with bundle_check consistent and discharged file_identity for the v4-profile bundle.
steps.verifier_gate: native-check exits 0; the v4-pinned identities re-derive under the same composite gate and check consistent.

steps.name: Struct field typed by a refined alias is rejected by the profile gate
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-attempt --core {mumei_bin} --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_composite_attempt/src/bad.mm --bundle {output_dir}/bad_bundle --output {output_dir}/bad_report.json > {output_dir}/bad.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/bad_report.json; cat {output_dir}/bad.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json, os; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bad_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-attempt-report/v1'; assert 'build_id' not in r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert 'candidate' not in r; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') not in (0, None), r['normalized']; assert not os.path.exists('{output_dir}/bad_bundle/native-bundle.json'), 'partial bundle emitted'; print('refined-alias field: no claimed build_id, no selection, no partial bundle')" && {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_composite_attempt/src/bad.mm -o {output_dir}/bad_bundle_direct > {output_dir}/bad_direct.log 2>&1; rc2=$?; cat {output_dir}/bad_direct.log; test $rc2 -ne 0 && grep -q 'native bundle rejected' {output_dir}/bad_direct.log && echo 'Core profile gate rejected the refined-alias field'
steps.artifact_contract: bad_report.json holds mumei.native-attempt-report/v1 with no build_id, no selected_result and a nonzero normalized exit_code; no bad_bundle/native-bundle.json is emitted; bad_direct.log records the Core gate's rejection diagnostic.
steps.verifier_gate: native-attempt exits 0 with an unselected lineage; the direct Core invocation exits nonzero with the profile-gate rejection diagnostic.
